title: Unmet: Faster outage detection
question: Is 'Unmet: Faster outage detection' really unserved for engineering and devops, and could a small agent-built product reach $1,000/month?

picos.comparator: Uptime.com Website Monitoring, Datadog, Grafana; workarounds and doing nothing
picos.outcomes: Less time spent on non-coding work, lower tool cost, fewer outages and errors, faster launch and first revenue, more users and signups, less churn and failed payments, less support load
picos.setting: Global, English-speaking online communities; web, browser, GitHub, app stores and plugin marketplaces; companies of 1-5 people

in: Low-touch SaaS tools for indie developers and solo founders that one person with an AI coding agent can build and run
out: Enterprise developer platforms sold through sales teams
General-purpose AI coding assistants and IDEs (frontier-lab territory)
Products that need regulated data (health, payments custody, KYC) or hardware

include: Products and services that do low-touch saas tools for indie developers and solo founders that one person with an ai coding agent can build and run for engineering and devops
Workarounds people use for the same job (spreadsheets, scripts, freelancers)
exclude: Aimed only at enterprises or teams larger than 50 (sales-only pricing, contact sales as the only plan)
Not a software product, workaround, directory or community (course, agency, newsletter); communities and directories are kept as reach channels per D06, not counted as competitors
General payment processors, banks or fintechs that hold funds or require merchant KYC; billing, merchant-of-record, dunning and license tools sold to software makers stay in scope
Dead: no activity within recency_days or announced shutdown
Duplicate or rebrand of an entity already listed

skills: product built by an AI coding agent (Claude Code) with web, API and browser-extension stacks
human helper for accounts, payments, posting and support triage
exclusions: heavy ongoing manual operations or content moderation
products needing paid ads to grow
unfair_advantages: can ship and iterate fast with coding agents
